sketch.name: FreightLaneMatrix
sketch.description: A freight lane matrix for ethanol shipping: lanes by Rail / Truck / Barge with rate per gallon, transit days and month-on-month trend, the cheapest mode per lane highlighted, a mode filter, and a demurrage aging strip underneath.
sketch.html: Freight lanes $/gal · transit days · vs last month

props.name: mode
props.description: Shows every mode, or only one mode's column.

props.name: selected
props.description: The selected lane (its lane string), highlighted in the matrix.

props.name: lanes
props.description: Lanes: { lane, origin, destination, railRate, railDays, railTrend, truckRate, truckDays, truckTrend, bargeRate, bargeDays, bargeTrend }; rate in $/gal, trend in % vs last month, rate 0 = mode not available.

props.name: demurrage
props.description: Demurrage aging buckets: { bucket, cars, amount } with amount in $ accrued.

sketch.notes: Simple control (rows are data, no designer-edited items). Cheapest available mode per lane is highlighted (green tint + dot) computed across all modes, even when the mode filter shows one column. Trend is % vs last month: up (costlier) red, down green. Demurrage strip: four buckets tinted from neutral to red, last two in red text; totals in the title. Fluid ~350x220 to 1100x600; lanes list scrolls, strip stays at the bottom. Meant for a GridBoard card with no outer chrome.
